summary: Support Wellman scaffold profiles in bootstrap work-start and adoption-plan ticket root creation

delivery.outcome: Accept all canonical Wellman scaffold profile IDs in work_start_check.py bootstrap_scaffold_at_head, ensure project/new-ticket.sh safely creates a missing non-symlink project/ parent directory in newly allocated worktrees whose committed base lacks project/, and release standard 0.20.153.
nonGoals: No relaxation of native governance manifest checks or GOV-TICKET-LOCK-003 collision detection
No changes to governance_check.py or target repositories inside this Governance Hub

architecture.decision: Align scripts/work_start_check.py bootstrap_scaffold_at_head with WELLMAN_SCAFFOLD_PROFILES from scripts/create_adoption_lock.py, guard and create missing dirname(ticket_dir) in project/new-ticket.sh before atomic mkdir "$ticket_dir", add regression coverage in tests/scaffold_bootstrap_test.py and tests/adoption_legacy_scaffold_test.py, and advance 0.20.153 version projections.
architecture.rollback: Revert through protected review; existing adoption locks and ticket schemas remain unchanged.

validation.evidence: bootstrap_scaffold_at_head accepts all canonical WELLMAN_SCAFFOLD_PROFILES and rejects unknown profiles and native governance manifests.
project/new-ticket.sh allocates a linked ticket worktree cleanly when the committed base has no project/ directory while still refusing symlinked project roots and duplicate ticket directories.
Bundled parity, version 0.20.153 parity, wheel build, and Governance Hub gate pass.
